#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int multiply(int a, int b, int n) {
    long long ab = (long long)a * b;
    return (int)(ab % n);
}

int inverse(int a, int n) {
    int m = n;
    int r1 = 1, r2 = 0, r3 = 0, r4 = 1;
    while (a > 0 && n > 0) {
        if (n >= a) {
            r3 -= r1 * (n / a);
            r4 -= r2 * (n / a);
            n %= a;
        } else {
            int tmp = a;
            a = n;
            n = tmp;
            tmp = r1;
            r1 = r3;
            r3 = tmp;
            tmp = r2;
            r2 = r4;
            r4 = tmp;
        }
    }
    if (a == 0) {
        if (r3 >= 0)
            return r3 % m;
        else
            return m + (r3 % m);
    } else {
        if (r1 >= 0)
            return r1 % m;
        else
            return m + (r1 % m);
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    const int P = 998244353;

    int n, real_k, l;
    cin >> n >> real_k >> l;

    vector<int> factorials(2 * n + 2, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= 2 * n + 1; i++) {
        factorials[i] = multiply(factorials[i - 1], i, P);
    }

    vector<int> doublefact(n + 1, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        doublefact[i] = multiply(doublefact[i - 1], 2 * i - 1, P);
    }

    vector<vector<int>> list(2 * n + 2, vector<int>(n + 1, 0));

    for (int r = 1; r <= 2 * n + 1; r++) {
        for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
            if (((r % 2) != (k % 2)) && (r - 1 >= k) && (2 * n + 1 - r >= k)) {
                int num = multiply(factorials[r - 1], factorials[2 * n + 1 - r], P);
                num = multiply(num, doublefact[(r - k - 1) / 2], P);
                num = multiply(num, doublefact[(2 * n + 1 - r - k) / 2], P);

                int denom = multiply(factorials[r - k - 1], factorials[2 * n + 1 - r - k], P);
                denom = multiply(denom, factorials[k], P);

                int inv_denom = inverse(multiply(denom, doublefact[n], P), P);
                list[r][k] = multiply(num, inv_denom, P);
            }
        }
    }

    int ans = 0;
    for (int r = 1; r <= 2 * n + 1; r++) {
        for (int k = real_k; k <= n; k++) {
            ans += list[r][k];
            ans %= P;
        }
    }

    ans = multiply(ans, l, P);
    int inv_2n1 = inverse(2 * n + 1, P);
    ans = multiply(ans, inv_2n1, P);

    cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
